description:
In resolve_local_hostname() (rnews_main.rs lines 384-390), if operator.hostname is absent AND /etc/hostname is absent or empty, the binary silently uses "localhost" as the Path: hostname. Every article stored to IPFS will have 'Path: localhost!...' in its canonical bytes, which is incorrect for any production deployment and will cause Path-loop detection to misfire on any peer that receives two articles from different 'localhost' nodes.

There is no tracing::warn! for this case. A maintainer diagnosing stale or duplicated articles at 3am has no log evidence that the binary ran with the wrong hostname.

Fix: add `tracing::warn!("operator.hostname not set and /etc/hostname not found; using 'localhost' — set operator.hostname in config");` in the else branch of resolve_local_hostname, or make the binary exit(1) if hostname resolves to 'localhost' without explicit config.
title: rnews_main: 'localhost' hostname fallback is silent — no warning emitted
